content:
We got list of templates. Need one for amide formation (acid + amine). The template with reaction_id 401931 seems to be amide formation from acid and amine? It shows product is amide with C=C. The retro_smarts_template: '[#7:2]-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:3])/[CH;D2;+0:4]=[C:5]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-O-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](-[#7:2])=[O;D1;H0:3].O-C(=O)-[CH;D2;+0:4]=[C:5]'. That's a bit complex but seems to break acid and amine to give amide. So we can use template_id 401931.

Now need sulfonamide formation template. Search for sulfonyl chloride + amine.
<thought>Search for templates that break sulfonyl chloride (S-Cl) and form sulfonamide (S-N).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonyl chloride"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamide"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
